author: Claire Lewis
description:
For the first time since its announcement during December 2023's The Game Awards, players are getting a look at the female player-character from its upcoming sci-fi RPG Exodus--which was full of Mass Effect DNA back when we previewed it in September.

The default female version of main character Jun Aslan was revealed today via a seven-minute featurette showing off both female-Jun's face and a bit more of the game itself. The trailer also provided a glimpse of a brief romance scene between female-Jun and Suliman, who is one of the game's romanceable NPCs.
title: BioWare Is Dead, But Mass Effect’s Spiritual Successor Exodus Just Gave Us A Glimpse of A Spicy Romance

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
There's only one game this week that everyone's talking about, but in my hunt for a suitable alternative to ease the wait, I stumbled upon Spirit Crossing. The cozy game is an MMO with life-simulation elements from the developers behind Cozy Grove. There's plenty to do initially, but I'm going to have to stop playing it to focus on GTA 6 because of its time-gating, and that's really frustrating.

In Spirit Crossing, you take on the role of a newcomer to the mysterious world of the Crosslands, where humans, spirits, and other unusual residents live together. You're not a warrior or a hero, or anything resembling a traditional RPG protagonist. Instead, you're working on building a community, customizing your own house, and helping misguided spirits.
title: This Cozy New MMO Is A Delight, But Time-Gating During GTA 6 Week Is A Tough Ask

author: Chris Pereira
description:
Grand Theft Auto VI's release is upon us, and as we've known for some time, it is a big install: roughly 212GB on both Xbox Series X|S and PS5. As such, it's close to a universal experience that everyone playing GTA has been looking for the games they can live without and uninstalling them.

In some cases, those might be live-service favorites that we're at least temporarily abandoning as we plan to invest time in what could be a very substantial runtime in GTA VI. For others, we're leaving behind those aspirational games--the I'll definitely get to it one day I swear ones that we're all lying to ourselves about. 

Of course, you can always re-download games in the future, but balancing the needs of future games, the somewhat inevitable size of GTA Online, and everything else you want to have available means making tough decisions. With that in mind, we're runni
title: The GTA 6 Uninstallation Graveyard: Everything We Deleted To Make Room

author: Jason Fanelli
description:
Earlier today, Geoff Keighley announced all of the nominees for The Game Awards 2026, the annual celebration of gaming held in Los Angeles. Among expected nominees Grand Theft Auto VI, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, and Control Resonant was one surprising name: 2XKO has been nominated for Best Fighting Game, despite Riot Games announcing the end of the game's lifecycle earlier this year.

Riot announced that "active development" for the fighting game, featuring characters from League of Legends, would end in December 2026. "Over the last few months, we’ve been monitoring 2XKO’s trajectory closely, and what we’ve seen is painting a clear, consistent picture," Riot said at the time. "While a lot of you jumped in to try the game and there
title: This Fighting Game Is Nominated For A TGA Despite Development Shutting Down

author: Eddie Makuch
description: The video game industry's woes continue as Take-Two's 2K division has confirmed that one third of the staff at Civilization and XCOM developer Firaxis Games is being laid off.
title: Civilization Dev Lays Off 1/3 Of  Staff, New XCOM Game Facing “Development Struggles” – Report

author: Alessandro Barbosa
description:
After months of searching and numerous potential frontrunners, Robert Pattinson has been cast as the next James Bond. It's lead to some questions about whether he's too famous or too old for the role, whether or not he looks like Bond, and just how different his portrayal might be to those that came before him. For some others, however, the questions is far more direct: What watch is he going to wear?

James Bond has long had recognizable brand associations, but one that has endured has been the partnership with luxury watch maker Omega. Bond was first seen wearing an Omega in 1995's GoldenEye, and was mostly recently seen sporting the latest iteration of the Seamaster Diver 300m in this year's
title: 007 First Light Might Be The End Of The Line For James Bond’s Favorite Watch

author: Levi Winslow
description:
The nominees for The Game Awards have been announced. Some of the biggest games--and those that aren't out yet--make appearances on the list, including Grand Theft Auto 6 and Phantom Blade Zero, but some of the games could've--and maybe should've--been nominated in multiple categories. So, let's go over some of the biggest subs at this year's TGAs.

Let's start with the big one: Game of the Year. You've got six games nominated here: 007 First Light,
title: These Are Some Of The Biggest Snubs At The Game Awards 2026

author: Alessandro Barbosa
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is now just a couple of hours away in some parts of the world. That is, if you're planning to play on either Xbox or PlayStation. The wait for a PC version is still ongoing, with Rockstar yet to indicate when it plans to release that port. In the meantime, however, you can start ensuring that your setup is at least ready for when it arrives.

High-end keycap manufacturer GMK has revealed a new set that is clearly inspired by GTA 6 and Vice City, without explicitly mentioning either. The new set, named Neon Vice, features black keycaps with an array of colored alphas and numerical keys, all drawing from the pink, orange, and purple colors of Rockstar's impending sequel. Novelty keycaps include images of speedboats across choppy water, palm trees, and alligators, and the Vice City skyline.
title: This GTA 6-Inspired Keycap Set Will Make The Wait For A PC Version Slightly Easier

author: Cameron Koch
description:
The nominees for 2026's The Game Awards have been revealed, and just like every year before it, there is a glaring omission in the Best Ongoing Game Category: World of Warcraft.

This year's nominees are Arc Raiders, Fortnite, No Man's Sky, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, and Final Fantasy 14 Online. Of particular note is Square Enix's MMORPG, which has been nominated in the category every year since 2021. Developer Blizzard's MMO, on the other hand, is nowhere to be seen. 

WoW is among the most popular live-service games in industry history and has been for 22 years. Blizzard releases new expansions for its MMORPG every other year like clockwork and has done so for over two decades. It reintroduced the old-school version of the MMO, Wo
title: What Does It Take For World Of Warcraft To Be Nominated At The Game Awards?

author: Alessandro Barbosa
description:
Last year, the Game of the Year category at Geoff Keighley's The Game Awards was stacked with independent games. It was a fitting celebration for a strong year of independent releases, which has been closely matched by some of the best indie games of this year. Why, then, have none of them been able to make the same impact year on year?

Last year, the category was dominated by indie games, with Hollow Knight: Silksong, Hades 2, and Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 all coming in as potential winners of the category. Sandfall Interactive, developers of Expedition 33, walked home the biggest winner, but it was clear that other AAA
title: After Indie Games Dominated The Game Awards Last Year, They’re Missing In 2026

author: Levi Winslow
description:
The Keighleys, or more formally, The Game Awards, are right around the corner. Ahead of its December 10 air date, host Geoff Keighley announced the nominees for the myriad categories, including Game of the Year. Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto 6 made the cut, but in an unusual circumstance, it did so before any reviews of the game have been published.

Before anyone has read any official take on GTA 6, Rockstar Games' action-adventure game has eight nominations, making it the most-nominated game at this year's The Game Awards.
title: GTA 6 Leads TGA Nominations, And Reviews Aren’t Even Live Yet

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
The actor playing Lucia in Grand Theft Auto 6 has been revealed, and it's Manni L. Perez, the person everyone expected it to be for a long time now. In fact, fans discovered that Perez was Lucia all the way back in 2023.

The news didn't come from Rockstar Games or the actor herself, but instead via The Game Awards. That's because Perez was nominated for Best Performance. GTA
title: GTA 6’s Lucia Actor Revealed, And It’s The Person Everyone Already Guessed

author: Jordan Ramée
description:
While Grand Theft Auto 6 is set to dominate what GameSpot covers for the next month (at least), it doesn't mean there aren't plenty of other games out there that those of us are playing at the same time (or in the cases of those of us who aren't big GTA fans, what we're playing instead). Whether it's a new demo for a game we're eagerly anticipating, an indie title that's bravely facing off against Rockstar's juggernaut of a title, or just something that made us smile, we want to take a chance to highlight those games too.

Below, you'll find a list of smaller or lesser-known games that we're playing alongside or instead of GTA 6, as well as links to our coverage of those titles. As we get into the thick of Grand Theft Auto 6 season, we'll keep coming back here to add additional impression pieces we want to highlight.
title: The New, Non-GTA 6 Games You Should Be Playing Right Now

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
It's almost time for The Game Awards to kick off a night of trailers and appreciation for the 2026 gaming year, but right now, it's time to see who's in the running to earn some well-deserved kudos. The 2026 Game Awards will be livestreamed from the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles on December 10, and nominees for the best games across several categories are about to be announced.

Like previous years, the nominees have been chosen by a global jury of media publications and creator outlets--including GameSpot--and they'll be announced through a dedicated livestream. If you want to see which games have made the cut, you can check the list below and hit your F5 key for an update as we keep track of them all.

Game of the Year

The best of the best for 2026, the game that excelled across multiple creative and technical fields.
title: All The Game Awards 2026 Nominees Revealed

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Jensen Huang, the co-founder of Nvidia who was recently ousted as CEO after he admitted to having an affair with someone that US intelligence believes could by a spy for China, has now said he is open to returning to the company.

In his first public statement since his resignation from Nvidia, Huang told The Wall Street Journal that he is aware of the "outpouring of calls" from Nvidia employees, investors, business partners, and customers for him to come back as CEO. He would come back, if asked.

"If the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO," he said.
title: Ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Breaks His Silence, Says He Would Come Back

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
We're all very familiar by now with the fact that GTA 6 will be available to players in New Zealand before the rest of us. We're not bitter about it either, honestly. Not a bit. In any event, you're probably worried about potentially seeing spoilers for the game you've been waiting 13 years for, and we're in the same boat. The trick is to build a, for lack of a better term, spoiler firewall to protect you from seeing anything you don't want to see on your perfectly-curated social media feeds.

There are different ways to do this depending on the platform in question, so we've curated a step-by-step guide for every social media outlet we can think of, as well as some more general tips to avoid GTA 6 spoilers this week. We'd recommend setting this up as soon as possible, since the
title: How To Avoid GTA 6 Spoilers On Your Social Media Feeds

description: Jean-Luc recommends Tanuki: Pon's Summer.
title: This Has the Soul of a GameCube Game

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 has a lot of details and depth, including dozens of different bird species for people to find. If you're a birder, you're in for a good time.

According to The Guardian, Rockstar confirmed that there are 62 types of birds that players can spot. Players can whip out binoculars to "study" birds and animals like they could in Rockstar's last game, Red Dead Redemption II.
title: GTA 6 Has A Lot Of Different Bird Species, Here’s How Many

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
All Elite Wrestling's recent Full Gear event had no shortage of great moments, but Austin Creed stole the show with a move straight out of Street Fighter. After teaming up with his Next Level partner Kofi Kingston and Swerve Strickland to take on Bandido, Hangman Adam Page, and Brody King in a Texas Death Match, anything went in this brawl — including vintage NES accessories.

Looking the worse for wear at King's hands, Creed busted out an NES Power Glove and landed a Shoryuken uppercut that exploded in a shower of sparks, knocking his burly foe flat on his back. The moment quickly went viral, and Creed's team would eventually triumph, emerging as the AEW World Trios Champions.

title: An NES Power Glove Just Became The Most Dangerous Weapon In Pro Wrestling

author: Callum Self
description:
CD Projekt Red’s Cyberpunk 2077 and The Witcher 3 are some of the best RPGs ever made thanks to an engrossing pair of worlds filled with lovable (and hateable) characters. I mean, how can you not love Panam, hate Adam Smasher, love Geralt, and hate the Bloody Baron? author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Ubisoft recently hired games industry veteran Christoph Hartmann to become the general manager of Creative House 2. In a new interview, Hartmann talked about his hopes for the unit, saying his dream would be for it to become "like the A24 of video games."

He told Variety that what he means by this is that Creative House 2 can be like A24 in that it can make games that are both critically and commercially successful. A24's biggest hit
title: New Ubisoft Boss Wants Studio To Become “A24 Of Video Games”

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Nintendo's The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake for Switch 2 is the best-selling physical game of 2026, according to Circana, but GTA 6 is coming out soon and could topple that record.

Circana's Mat Piscatella said the Ocarina of Time remake for Switch 2 was the fir
title: Ocarina Of Time Is 2026’s Best-Selling Physical Game In The US, But GTA 6 Is Coming

author: Ana Diaz
description:
Every time I enter the team lobby in Deadlock, I start a match by sending one message: “HI IM REM.”

Rem is a rat/crow/cat-looking fantasy critter in Valve's online team-based shooter Deadlock. The game blends genre elements from both team-based hero shooters and multiplayer online battle arena games. The developers still describe it as being in “early development,” but it’s already widely popular. Deadlock had more than 300,000 concurrent players on Steam in October, according to SteamDB, and the game has already inspired a vibrant fandom on social media platforms like TikTok and Instagram.
title: Deadlock Has Convinced Me We Should All Be Role-Playing In Competitive Games

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Don't get too comfortable with your Xbox Game Pass library, because you never know which game will be removed from it next. This month, several more games are on their way out on November 30, so say goodbye to deadly xenomorphs, even deadlier house spiders, and a Cold War battleground infested with killer robots.

One of the biggest departures this month is Aliens: Dark Descent. It's a solid entry in the Aliens franchise if you don't mind some base-management chores, as it nails the atmosphere of the classic sequel while giving you plenty of acid-blooded bugs to mow down.

This month will also see the 17th Century Ghostbusters game, Banishers: Ghost of New Ed
title: Xbox Game Pass Is Losing 8 More Games In November

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
As generative AI enters live-service games, conversational NPCs present exciting creative possibilities for those who choose to use them. However, it also presents a serious moderation challenge. In HoYoverse's upcoming cozy life sim Petit Planet, players can visit a local cafe run by an AI-driven NPC called Nalo. Nalo will remember past conversations and use them to deliver dynamic, personalized responses. 

However, during closed beta testing, some unsettling interactions involving heavy or self-destructive topics of conversation were noticed. Speaking to GameSpot at HoYoverse's recent media week in Seoul, South Korea, developers Yinli Huang and Murphy addressed safety concerns, outlining how the studio is combining a series of moderation systems to ensure player safety. 

When asked h
title: How HoYoverse Is Keeping Petit Planet’s AI NPCs From Harassing Players

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Rockstar Games has found an unexpected partner to show off one of GTA 6's most impressive features: The Weather Channel. The US broadcaster has shared an exclusive look at Leonida's weather system via six new screenshots and forecasts that make the fictional destination sound like somewhere you'd need to check the weather before visiting.

It's an unusual collaboration, but a very fitting one. GTA 6 takes place in Leonida, a fictional state inspired by Florida, where sunshine, torrential rain, thunderstorms and tropical storms are all part of the ecosystem. Who better to show off the unpredictable climate than The Weather Channel?
title: GTA 6 Has Teamed Up With The Weather Channel To Show How Dynamic Leonida Can Be

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Due to GTA 6's non-simultaneous release, people in New Zealand will be the first in the world to play the highly anticipated open-world crime game when it releases at midnight local time there.

If you want to become a Kiwi for a day and you plan to play on Xbox, you can trick your console into thinking it's in New Zealand to play early.

title: How To Play GTA 6 Early On Xbox Using This Trick
